name: Irish War of Independence
title: Irish War of Independence
summary: A guerrilla war fought in Ireland from 1919 to 1921 between the Irish Republican Army and British forces: the British Army, along with the quasi-military Royal Irish Constabulary and its paramilitary forces the Auxiliaries and Ulster Special Constabulary.
result: Creation of the Irish Free State and Northern Ireland

combatants: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

ending.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
